name: fire-burnout-stone
comment: BlockFire with nothing to burn (BlockFire.java:55-113, :181-199): fire set on stone (ages 0, 2, 3, 4 and 14) ages by nextInt(3)/2 per tick and goes out at the first tick that sees an age above 3 (no flammable neighbour, a normal cube below); on netherrack it never goes out; on obsidian onBlockAdded asks BlockPortal.tryToCreatePortal (no frame here, so false: the Rust port records it as a gap and answers false); on glass and in the air onBlockAdded removes it at once (not a normal cube below, nothing flammable). A fire of age 15 set at t=120. block_box every 5 ticks, scheduled_ticks every 5, rng_state every tick.
